nom: Peter Thomas Roth Anti-Aging Cleansing Gel

avis.texte: Great cleanser!! I am in my late sixties and continue to return to using this wonderful cleanser. Not to hartsh for older skin.

I have been using this for over ten years to tackle adult acne. It is an excellent product. Unfortunately, with the new bottle they have also reduced the ounces significantly while the price has stayed the same. The pump encourages you to use a lot.

I bought this when it was on sale for $15. I do not normally buy Peter Thomas Roth products due to their cost. It cleans efficiently and does not dry out my skin. I use different products in winter because I suffer from dry skin then.

Reminds me of the orange neutrogena face wash. It didnt do much for anti aging, my skin looked the same except for the drying. I have oily skin but this cleanser really dried my skin out and stripped my natural oils.
It's a great face wash, but I won't be buying it again because the product has been downsized.

I used Truly Anti-aging gel facial cleanser for years but it is no longer available. I googled to find a similar product. This is awfully close. The scent isn't too strong. It rinses off easily without feeling residue left on skin. It took 1-2 weeks to notice a difference. My pores appear smaller and my skin is brighter. Actually, this is probably the best my skin has ever looked and I'm 58!!
Does not irritate and keeps you as young as can be. I have very sensitive skin and this works great!

I bought this about a month ago and wanted to wait before I did a review to see how my face reacted and honestly it has been a positive reaction. I'm 47 and I am liking this product. I will definitely keep it going.
I actually like the cleansing oil better but Ulta stopped carrying it. This is a nice alternative but not as effective on mascara as the oil.

Very nice face cleaner. No residue left behind. Does not dry my skin out. A bit disappointed bottle went from 8.5 Oz to 6.7 and now has a pump. Price per oz increases, and if you're not careful with the pump, you'll use way to much product. Little goes a long way

avis.titre: Did you think we wouldn't notice?!?!
avis.texte: 20% less product in this new bottle, but not 20% less in price
I have used many different facial cleansers; some of which are very good. However, I always come back to this one by PTR. It's excellent!

avis.titre: Love the product, bummed about the new bottle
avis.texte: I swear by this cleanser. It cleanses as deeply as the OG, Neutrogena orange cleanser. BUT it doesn't dry my skin out as much. I waited and waited for it to be back in stock after being sold out here for about a month. Turns out the packaging was changing and now the bottle is about 4oz smaller. It is slightly cheaper, and the addition of the pump is nice. But note that when you use the pump it gives you way too much product. You do not need to use the huge amount that comes out with 1 full pump. You need less than half of what it gives. So be careful not to waste it!

I have heard nothing but positive things about this brand. I took the chance after a sales associate recommended this, saying she loves it. Three days after using it, my face has broken into a rash with extreme dryness. Will be returning immediately

The first time I used it, my face felt so smooth. I couldn't believe it. I always use philosophy face wash and feel like it's a great brand. It does sting if I get it in my eyes but that's to be expected.

avis.titre: Loved this product - especially the sale price!
avis.texte: I would never have tried this as a new cleanser if it had not been spotlighted during the last sale! With the great price and a recommendation from an associate, I found my new favorite! Pleasant scent, gel to foam. Left my skin clean and soft!!
caught the sale. bought one bottle went back and bought 4 more. cleared my 4 month cystic jaw acne in 3 days!!!!!
I love this cleanser! I use this 4x/week and it has helped with my oily/acne prone skin. It also brightens my face after each use. Will keep repurchasing.
Awesome cleanser that targets more than one area of concern for anti-aging. Cleans without stripping. Beneficial ingredients. Worth the money!

avis.titre: NOT FOR SENSITIVE SKIN AT ALL!
avis.texte: I bought this cleanser for my mature skin. I like the brand however, this particular cleanser, it's overpriced and it irritated my skin so much I broke out in a rash, all over my face. I thought maybe I'll give it a few more days and it will go away. NOPE! I kept getting more white pimples. It was so bad I was embarrassed to go to work. I ended up throwing the bottle away. 😞

I would love this product more if it didn't have red dye 40. Like, what purpose does it serve? For that reason, I won't buy it again. Which is sad because it does make my skin look brighter and clears my skin.

I am almost running out of this product and I have to buy some more overall this is a great cleanser. It definitely cleared up my skin and makes your skin feel fresh. It has a really nice scent to it and for the price you get a really big bottle because a little goes along way and it last for a long time, it's definitely been helping with my skin because I wanted something that is anti-aging. I'm not old but I like to do skin care and I really like this product. It's definitely been helping me out and ever since I've been using it. I hardly get any pimples and my skin looks clear and brighter.

I've been using this for a year now and I love it. It smells so good and I feel so refreshed after cleansing. It has a long shelf life too which is great since I don't necessarily need to use it daily. I don't use it in the summer since there's a sun warning on the back.

I purchased this yesterday. I used last night, and again this morning and already noticed the nagging blemishes (not fully acne, but little annoyances) was cleared up after months of hanging around. My skin feels smoother and looks brighter. Smells amazing. Can't wait to see what this does over time!!!
This is my go to face wash. It hydrates my skin and my skin is so soft
Tried all types of face washes but this is the very best. Been using it for 6 years.
May have made my face a little dry at first but after a couple days it was good! I really like this product!

The first time i used it, i liked it! The smell was nice and the chemical exfoliation left my skin clear. Used a couple more times and i now have hives on my neck/cheeks. I also dont like that there are unnecessary chemicals in this product—juat a personal preference though. I would not recommend this in general, as there are gentler cleansers out there for more affordable prices. Sensitive skin people stay far away

This cleanser makes my skin feel so clean and refreshed. It easily removes the makeup residue and oils after using a makeup remover. This has a pleasant smell and isn't very drying. I have combination skin and aging skin. I use this once a day.
I don't know if this product delivers on its promises but I feel that my skin is clean after using without any dryness. There is a slight scent. A little goes a long way.

I had horrible acne for years, off and on trying products with little to no results and this cleanser gave me the best results. It almost completely reduced the redness and size of my pores and made my skin so much brighter and bouncier. i would seriously recommend this to everyone. Not enough stars!!

I love PTR products but this one did not work out for me. First i noticed it sucked all of the moisture from my skin and It felt dry even after moisturizing it. Then I developed a nasty rash that pealed and was Red and itchy. I discontinued use Ava the rash got better, tried it again and The rash came back. I won't be using again. However, my husband loves it

I tried this for the first time 3 months ago and I'm hooked! This bottle has lasted that long and I'm just now needing to reorder. I am 41, and notice the difference in my skin by adding this to my skin care routine. It smells great, removes makeup residue and oil without drying out. My skin feels soft and clean before applying my serum and lotion.

I've been using this cleanser for probably 6 years and have loved it. This current bottle I have is definitely not the same!!! It smells different, feels different and the color is slightly lighter. I'm disappointed that something has changed!
Don't use with a retinoid ... read product interactions before use

avis.titre: Waterd down and no longer a gel
avis.texte: I've used this cleansing gel for several years. You didn't need to use much. The last bottle I purchased seemed to be watered down and no longer had a gel consistently. I thought it might be fluke and bought another bottle. My recent purchase was also watered down. You have to use more than before. It's disappointing it was changed. I won't buy it again!
Face feels clean of oils and makeup without feeling stripped of moisture
I got this last year in the 21 days of beauty sale. I finished that bottle and bought it again. This has been the best cleanser I've used. It leaves your skin feeling refreshed, clean, and brighter.

This cleanser is very drying. I thought it was just the winter months but realized after I started using this cleanser my skin was drier than usual. I have to use a lot of moisturizer and still my skin is dry. I will need to stop using it.

I have used(and loved) this face wash for a year. I won't hesitate to use it for another year.The first 2ish weeks did make it itchy but I'm so glad that I continued using it. I have seen improvement in my skin texture and lines over the last year. I used to have to exfoliate every week and I don't have to anymore. It does have a strong smell, but you get used to it. The bottle is expensive but because this bottle lasts literally 1 year it's cheaper than buying multiple bottles of face wash each year. My face didn't get used to it so I have been able to use the same bottle for the whole time- it's been helpful all year. Coming from combination skin that is textured. I love it. I'd buy it every year until I die.

I use several and love Peter Thomas Roth products so I was excited to try this face wash. The bottle does say "for all skin types except sensitive" but I've never had any issues with sensitivity so I thought nothing of it. A few hours after using it I was at a party and noticed that my eyelids were oddly itcy. Not terrible, just a bit annoying but I didn't connect it to the face wash. I used it twice more and started to notice not only itching but peeling skin around my eyes AND now my lips. Its been a week since I used it abs and I'm still dealing with the dryness and itching.
I like the consistency of this product but for some reason it always makes my eyebrows itch and because of that I can no longer use it.

I picked this up because it was on sale and I was looking to up my game on cleansers. I read the reviews before purchasing and thought it would be a good thing for me too. I didn't like the scent or how it left my face feeling super dried out. I felt like I needed to apply a heavy-duty moisturizer after using it. I was only able to use it two times before I wanted to return it to the store.
Skin feels clean & refreshed but not dry. Great, gentle, non-scrubby exfoliation that leaves skin glowy and bright.
My skin feels super soft and clean after using it. My skin feels firm, but not in an overly tight way. Have only been using for a week, so can't say as far as anti-aging results, but so far so good!

I used this face wash once and ordered more immediately after. The smell of this product is light and just the right amount of peach. Despite the negative reviews about sensitive skin (which it clearly states not to use in sensitive skin) I was pleasantly surprised.

avis.titre: I wanted to love it but...
avis.texte: it broke me out really bad and I don't have sensitive skin and I don't usually break out!
This has a good scent. It is light and fresh. It makes my skin feel clean. I've used this years ago and loved it. I used this a couple times a week and use a different cleanser the other days.
I love this face wash and have used it on my body as well for acne. I don't do sulfates anymore so I won't use this. Please please make your products sulfate and paraben free!!!

avis.titre: Peter Thomas Roth anti aging face wash
avis.texte: Both myself and husband have been using this product for over 11 years. We love it!
Smells peachy I like the scent love the ingredients. It's a nice size bottle for the money last a long time! Worth it.

avis.titre: The first step to glowing skin
avis.texte: I use this 3-4 times a week without issue and I have oily skin. This also plays well with the brand's Retinol Fusion PM. I get so many compliments on my glowing skin. Basically, this stuff works but you have to know a bit about proper skincare. Like, DO NOT use chemical exfoliants, like this cleanser, daily! Give your skin a break. Also, always follow up with a hydrating moisturizer (try PTR's Water Drench or Neutrogena's Hydroboost or Rovectin's Lotus Water Cream. I do not recommend Tatcha). And do not forget to wear sunscreen. The AHAs and BHAs in this sensitize your skin and make it easier for the sun to damage it.
I love this. It gets my face really clean. It has a great smell too.

Everyone was right. I only use this once a month to try and get rid of it bc it is extremely drying… and I have oily skin !!! When I use this my skin starts flaking and gets textured for a couple of days .
I have dry skin so I use it only every other day and I put on a hydrating mask afterward.
It dries my skin out horribly. I have combination skin but it got extremely dry. Would only recommend for people with oily skin and not too often either.
I always come back to this product because it leaves your face clean and fresh. No residue left behind.

avis.titre: Been using this cleanser for 7+ years
avis.texte: Skin feels squeaky clean, but not dried out, after using this cleaner. I've been using it in my rotation for many years, and love it.
I was very disappointed. It dried out my skin. Will not be purchasing again.
This is the only cleanser I've tried that removes all my makeup. I stock up when it's on sale
Only a small dab will do it. This product is amazing for me. It works exactly how they say it would. I have been using it for years now It is definitely one of my favs

Wouldn't recommend using it everyday but maybe 1-2 a week and not consecutively. It drys out my face bad and didn't see any good results. I've had this for probably for over a year now and nothing good has come of it.

Doesn't take off all makeup (and I don't use waterproof makeup), burns eyes, not gentle. It smells nice though, that's the only positive. I have to use oil to rid of makeup and follow up with philosophy cleanser to get the best results.

I guess if you're young like me (21) don't try this. I have regular skin type and I used this for 4-5 days straight and now my skin is irritating & burns (have to wait for it to go away, maybe couple days hopefully) I wanted to prevent for future wrinkles and etc but if you're older I guess this will work for you.
I use this for the second step in my night time routine. It always removes what ever makeup is left. Plus it cleans out my wash cloth of makeup.

Unlike other face washes this one does not dry my skin out and gives visible anti aging benefits. I definitely tried just about every thing in the book and this one wins for me! I'm a fan of many Peter Thomas Roth products
I've been using this cleanser (and other PTR products) on and off for almost 20 years…. It's simply the best!

I have been using this product for the past 3 years. The combination of glycolic and salicylic acid can have a harsh effect on skin, which is why I only use it at night. It helps fight acne AND is anti-aging and I can definitely see the difference when I miss a night or two.

i've used it all. from drug store to big names, peter thomas roth leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean without over doing it or over drying. i do not have sensitive skin and the bottle does say to avoid if you do. the fragrance is light and pretty, a little goes a long way. my skin stays clear using this product.
Use this everyday and love the results. Leaves skin feeling clean and soft without drying it out.

Wonderful cleanser! It has brightened my skin ever since I started using it with the Lancome toner. It can be drying so a moisturizer is especially needed, although it's worth every penny and you get a lot of product for the price. Anytime I notice a breakout coming on, as soon as I cleanse my face with this, it disappears. Highly recommend.

I received this product as a gift and was excited to use because I love Peter Thomas Roth's products. This cleanser dried my face out so bad. I just moved to a dryer climate, but when I used this product, I was living in a high humidity climate and I had never experienced ashy, flaky dry skin before. I use a rich moisturizer everyday and after using this product, my moisturizer couldn't rehydrate my skin. I spent 3 days eating so many cucumbers and papayas trying to get my face rehydrated. I now live in a dry climate and my face doesn't even come close to what happened after I used this product.

I NEVER leave reviews and have normal skin. Not sensitive at all. One day I noticed my neck was SO red. Then the next day the same thing. I couldn't figure out why until I realized it was from this cleanser completely DRYING out my skin. Not only on my neck but my face started drying out so bad and was flaking! I have never had this problem with any skincare product or face wash. Unbelievably horrible!

I've been using this daily for the last year and a half. It made a night and day difference in the brightness and evenness of my skin almost immediately. An unrelenting case of rosacea also stopped. It leaves my face SO soft. It has faded a couple of scars from psoriasis. My son had horrible acne. This has helped stop it In its tracks and helped to fade his scars. Looks like it's going to get rid of them completely. Yes it is very drying if you do not use a moisturizer as anything else that has salicylic or glycolic acid does. This also has a lot of citric acids (vitamin c) that also can be irritant to sensitive skin. Mine is fairly sensitive but I've had no issues. I use Clinique Moisture Surge gel faithfully every single day following my shower and have zero drying issues. My son does as well and his skin is super prone to drying but has no issues as long as he uses the moisture surge with it. It leaves my skin so soft, I have started adding a small drop to my body wash when I shower and the rest of my body is getting the same benefits my face has. Can't rave about this enough. Use a good moisturizer with it and you'll be fine. Doesn't need to be a heavy one, just very hydrating. Avoid doubling up on anything else that has citric/ascorbic acid/vitamin c, salicylic acid (most acne washes), glycolic acid or benzoyl peroxide in it as it will be too much and will cause inflammation. Just pay attention to what is in your products. If you use retinol products, try to use them sep

avis.titre: So Worth the Money, but requires a STRONG moisturizer
avis.texte: If you don't use a strong moisturizer with this, your skin WILL peel and feel like a terrible sunburn. Intense cleansing needs deep moisture. Since finishing the travel sized version, I can vouch that it made my skin more shiny and supple, and blasted away acne, redness, and texture. Pricey, but so worth the money if you build a great routine around it!

I've had the same bottle for over 6 months and it's still going strong. You only need a little amount to wash and lather your face. I never feel right afterwards but I feel that it definitely takes off all of my makeup and cleans my skin.
Works in my acne. Generous portion. It is costly but worth the s as mount received.
Was given as a gift last year and this is the best cleansing gel I have ever used. My face and pores look great.

Bought during 21 days of beauty and am so happy I did. Love the smell, cleans perfectly but doesn't dry my skin out and it's safe to use with my lash extensions. Full price seemed a bit high before I tried it but I will continue to purchase even at full price because you only need a small amount so the bottle lasts forever!

I love this! I am in my late 30's and keeping my skin looking young has turned into an obsession (lol). I have VERY sensitive skin, have a very oily T zone, and very dry patches in other areas. I cannot use this every day or it will dry my skin out to much. So I use this 2-3 times a week and it helps keep my skin clear and glowing without being to abrasive.
Love love and love! I wish it was fragrance free but other then that it's a great product! Makes my skin feel amazing!

This cleanser completely dried out my skin. I have always had oily skin so the fact that this product was strong enough to really dry it out the way it did is upsetting. I had dry patches around my nose & my chin. Waste of money.

I immediately loved the smell of this! I did not notice the bottle says for all skin types except sensitive until I was using it for the first time. Well they aren't joking. I had no problems, so I continued using it. About a week and a half in, I started noticing my skin drying out. Didn't think much of it because the weather getting cooler. A couple more days went by and I got a couple of pimples...like deep, painful ones. That happens once or twice a year, so I continued using it. I started noticing about one new pimple everyday. I was getting them on my forehead, jawline, cheeks. UGH! Luckily I had a travel size Dermalogica cleanser sitting around, so I tried that and my skin cleared in three days!! Back to Dermalogica, which I love, but I so badly wanted this to help with my aging skin.

I had this sample for awhile and decided to try it. I used it as my cleanser to wash my face, because I use a different one to cleanse my makeup off, and I love the soft and smooth lather of the ptr. I am actually quite surprised. I figured it would leave a sticky residue and feel greasy, but it did not. I really like it. I have sensitive skin and it didn't irriate me.

I love products from Peter Thomas Roth, but this cleanser makes my entire face bright red. I have slightly sensitive skin, but I have never seen a cleanser cause such a reaction. I'm disappointed because this was a gift. I'll have to return it.
I Put it in the shower and keep it until I'm done. I like how my face feels after using it.
This is the best facial cleanser I've ever used. While washing it tingles. Feels so good. When you rinse it leave your skin feeling rejuvenated, soft and moisturizer. I absolutely love it!!!!!!
I love how clean my face feels. I love how my skin feels.. I use this with my Clarisonic Mia... every night! My moisturizer really absorbs in afterwards! My all time favorite facial cleanser!

I bought this on a whim because it was 1/2 off. The size is nice and it smells great. I alternate between this and the glow recipe blueberry bounce cleanser. Both are effective at cleaning and gently exfoliating. This one has a slightly better price if purchasing both at full price based upon the size.

It's probably a bit expensive for the size, but it's a wonderful, effective cleanser that is loved as much by my husband and male friends as by me. It doesn't irritate, it takes off makeup well as a second cleanse and is a solid morning cleanser. Love the texture, the smell and the after skin.

I have tried so many cleansers. My favorite is PTR Rose Stem Cell but this appears to be discontinued so this is my new favorite. Very similar and leaves my skin soft and smooth. Gets rid of any bumps and roughness. I leave it on for a few minutes before rinsing. I am 60 and have an arsenal of products!
You only need a very tiny amount to get big time clean results that are not stripping to your skin. I would and will buy again but this bottle will last a very long time!

I've been using this cleanser for several years now. You only need a small amount, it lathers up which I like and it leaves my skin clean without feeling "stripped" of oils, etc. It's a very good value.

avis.titre: Chemical burns on my face, eye lids, and neck!
avis.texte: I originally thoughts this was awesome until I have chemical burns in my neck and face now!!!!

Age: 25 Skin Type: Normal So I got this as a promotion add on sample this so I'm happy I didn't end up paying for the product. At first it was great, I could see some more brightness in my skin but after about 1 1/2 weeks of use my skin started to get REALLY dry even with my use of serum and moisturizer I use. My skin also started to get flaky which definitely wasn't a desired aspect. This product is probably better for older users with more Anti-Aging concerns but if you're in my age range this might not be something you necessarily need. So two stars for the reaction with my skin BUT the product does smell nice and the gel formula is great and not to slippery.

I got a bottle of this in a PTR set, and I'm very disappointed with it. It reminds me of drug-store foaming face wash. I find it drying and hard to rinse. I'm trying to use it up in the shower, as I can't stand using it as a PM make up remover. I don't see any anti-aging benefit to this at all! It's hard to believe this is a PTR product, as I'm usually so impressed with the hydration and gentleness of this line. It's definitely a dudd for me!
Good product for aging skin that still has breakouts. Doesn't dry and minimizes pores. I use daily without issue.

I've been using this face wash for most of my 30s (I'm 37 now). This face wash isn't drying or moisturizing and helps my skin feel clean and balanced. I have changed it up to try new things once in awhile but I haven't found anything as good as this. I pair this with the cloud moisturizer and I get so many compliments on how glowy and youthful my skin looks
I have used this cleanser for a while now and I love it! My skin feels soft and clean and never dried out. I have tried others but always come back to PRT!

I've only been using for a week but I absolutely love it. You only need to use a very small amount so the bottle will last a long time. Very gentle on my skin and my face feels very clean after using! My skin is definitely looking brighter and it is helping with the fine lines which was what I was hoping for! Smells nice too. 10/10 would recommend

I got this in one of those sets on sale with 4 full sized products, so I figured I'd give it a try. It's a really nice size and it's true: you don't need a lot of it. I do enjoy the grapefruit smell that many others have been commenting about. HOWEVER, I began to get little bumps along my lower cheeks/jawline and I wondered what'd caused this? The reaction didn't appear initially, but this is the only thing I've changed in my routine and the bumps became apparent almost 2 weeks into using this product, so my conclusion is my breakouts were caused by this face wash. The thing is, I don't have very sensitive skin and I'm not easily prone to break outs, so the way my skin reacted has really made my confidence level go way down and I'm really embarrassed by the acne it caused... I really wanted to love it, and I'm sure it works great for other people, but be warned! For reference, I have oily/ combo, medium skin.

I have not been using it long enough to see long term benefits but it reduces lines immediately after I use it. It is a pretty big bottle and you do not need very much. It smells great. I was worried because it it's anti-aging that it would be too moist for my skin but it has not it just feels really soft. I have not had any breakout from it either.

I have been using this product for over a year now and I have to say it is wonderful! I do have sensitive skin, so I only use this at night. It is a great cleanser that helps remove make-up and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and tight! I get bored of the same skin care routine at times so I have tried other face washes to replace this one and NOTHING compares. I always go back to it because it just works!

Love love love. The smell, the smooth texture from it, suds up great, and does well with taking off my liquid eyeliner. The smell is so refreshing as well. Though, i did see and increase of the price .
You see and feel the results immediately younger softer and supple skin this will stay part of my skin care routine

Hands down my favorite night time face wash, after I rinse it off and pat my skin dry I'm still amazed at how smooth and soft my skin feels. It also leaves my skin prepped for my night time treatment. Which I have also seen better results with in conjunction with this cleanser.

avis.titre: Best face wash I've ever used
avis.texte: Okay it's only day 1, but already can tell the difference. I have sensitive skin and thought all face cleansers dried everyone's skin out, I always had to rush and put lotion on immediately. This, however, was so gentle on my skin I had time to chill for a minute, put my serum on let that soak in nicely, then put on lotion without feeling uncomfortable. I love this stuff.
